findings.title_en: Protruding reinforcing bars without protective caps
Simultaneous work above a worker on the lower level
Hanging strap with unconfirmed securing below the lower platform

summary_en: There are three findings: one high, one medium, and one low severity. The most urgent item is the protruding reinforcing bars without protective caps on the upper level. Work must stop in the reinforcing-bar area until all protruding ends are protected and verified.
